title: A quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals cuts out a closed subscheme, locally Spec(R/I)
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal J\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals [pqf-def-coherent]. Then there is a closed immersion $i:Z\to X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose ideal sheaf $\ker(\mathcal O_X\to i_*\mathcal O_Z)$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] equals $\mathcal J$, and for every affine open $U\subseteq X$ with $R=\mathcal O_X(U)$, $U\cong\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], the open subscheme $i^{-1}(U)$ of $Z$ is affine and $i^{-1}(U)\to U$ is identified, over $U\cong\operatorname{Spec}R$, with the morphism $\operatorname{Spec}(R/\mathcal J(U))\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ induced by the quotient map $R\to R/\mathcal J(U)$. ($Z$ is the closed subscheme of $X$ cut out by $\mathcal J$.)
